startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The URL of the Finn.no search/category page to start scraping from. For example: https://www.finn.no/realestate/homes/search.html or https://www.finn.no/car/used/search.html

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to scrape. Each page typically contains 20-50 listings.
